mapper.select: SELECT id, title, author, description, number, created_at, updated_at FROM book
SELECT id, title, author, description, number, created_at, updated_at FROM book WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book (title, author, description, number, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{author}, #{description}, #{number}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
